Name: True to Original HD Female Portraits
Author: tted86
Description:
Perhaps such a mod exists, regardless I could not find it or of sufficient quality so I made this one.  True to Original HD Female Portraits (39 Portraits).  It is intended to work with portraiture which requires SMAPI, and means it doesn't instantaneously change the portraits.  You have to extract the images to Portraiture\Portraits.  Then you have to interact with all the female characters in stardew valley and cycle through the portraits until you land on the correct HD one and lock it in.  However, before you do this, make sure you are happy with each portrait for each character.  This provides a faithful HD baseline.  Be warned, Pam is extra hideous :)  Don't ask for a male version without sending 15$ my way.
